input.quote: 15. ASSIGNMENT OR TRANSFER. Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
input.rationale: Section 15 is the only assignment provision in the Agreement. It bars assignment by either party absent the other's prior written approval, with a carve-out only for assignment to a financially responsible affiliate. It therefore fails the fallback on two material terms: there is no successor/M&A carve-out permitting Client to assign to a purchaser in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, and the consent standard is unqualified (no "not to be unreasonably withheld"), so TrueLink could block a corporate transaction at will. The clause does at least avoid walk-away territory — there is no Vendor termination or re-pricing right triggered by a Client change of control anywhere in the document (no "change of control" language appears), and Section 13/14 termination rights are not CoC-linked. The redline adds the affiliate/successor carve-out for Client, applies a reasonableness standard and a competitor bar to TrueLink assignments, and confirms a Client change of control is not an assignment, reaching the preferred position with the smallest workable edit.

proposal.summary: Add successor/M&A carve-out for Client assignments, a reasonableness standard on consent to TrueLink assignments, no assignment to a Client competitor, and confirm a Client change of control is not an assignment.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need to be able to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without consent, and to confirm that a change of control on our side is not an assignment and gives TrueLink no exit or re-pricing right. We have kept TrueLink's assignments subject to our consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, and excluded assignment to our competitors; if helpful, we can accept a mutual notice-based successor right with consent not unreasonably withheld for all other assignments.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: Client may assign or transfer this Agreement, and its rights and obligations hereunder, without the prior approval of TrueLink, to a financially responsible affiliate or to a successor in interest by way of merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or of the business to which this Agreement relates. TrueLink shall not assign or transfer any of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written approval of Client, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld, and in no event to a competitor of Client. A change of control of Client shall not constitute an assignment or transfer under this Agreement and shall not give TrueLink any right to terminate, re-price or modify this Agreement.
